idea.name: Temporary construction fence rental
idea.one_liner: Rent temporary fence panels to construction sites, found by driving past new sites (or via building permits), charged per linear foot per month for the life of the build
idea.revenue_model: rental per linear foot per month

key_quotes.quote: And then how he would get his customers is he would just go to construction sites that are new that didn't have any temporary fencing up yet and he would just say, "Do you want a temporary fence?
If you wanted, you could like anyone in the world can see uh building permits when they're file filed.
So, for max two days at the very start and two days at the very end, you're working.

claims.claim: Charged ~$4/ft dropping to $2/ft for long jobs
claims.quote: He would charge like four bucks a foot and then maybe eventually it'd get down to like two bucks a foot if they had it for a longer amount of time,
And he started growing it and he was making I asked him he'd make like 20 to 30k a job.
Well, he made several hundred grand while doing it and then sold the company for 600 grand 18 months later,

idea.name: Portable mini-golf hole rentals for events
idea.one_liner: Build portable 2x4/astroturf mini-golf holes and rent them to weddings and parties at $300/hole/day (or sell them), listed free on Facebook Marketplace

key_quotes.quote: But his biggest business is renting them out to weddings, events, parties, etc. for $300 per hole per day, which is less than the cost of the materials, right?

claims.claim: Sells holes for hundreds up to ~$1,000
claims.quote: And so he he sells these for hundreds of dollars, maybe even close to $1,000 each.
And to, you know, math into this $10,000 a month, you basically need to rent out 35 of them if it's $300 a piece.

idea.name: Original art import arbitrage
idea.one_liner: Buy cheap original art from small shops abroad (in person or via FaceTime/WhatsApp), pre-sell photos on Facebook Marketplace/Instagram with deposits, then ship and resell for several times cost

key_quotes.quote: Also use a credit card to buy artwork, bring it back home, sell it to pay off the credit card.
Can you just take your iPhone, take pictures, like nice pictures up close of each piece of artwork you have and text them to me, WhatsApp them to me, whatever.

claims.claim: Bought 12-14 originals, selling for a few hundred each
claims.quote: I don't think she's telling that many people how much she actually spent cuz she's selling these for like a few hundred bucks each.
So, she's probably paying like 50 to 100 bucks, I'm guessing.

ideas.other_uk_rules: Import VAT (reduced 5% for works of art) and customs declarations

idea.name: Vintage Japanese watch import reselling
idea.one_liner: FaceTime vintage watch shops in Japan, buy unique sub-$100 local-brand watches, and resell via Facebook Marketplace and social content

key_quotes.quote: If you can find a watch in Japan for 40 bucks, send you a picture of it, and then find me on Facebook Marketplace, and I'd be willing to pay 80, well, everybody wins.

idea.name: Cross-border regional food product resale
idea.one_liner: Import distinctive regional products (e.g. Hungarian paprika) between any two countries and sell with social content/ads

key_quotes.quote: You know, from Poland to Colombia or Argentina like it doesn't have to only be to the US or Colombia to Poland like like unique food products.

ideas.other_uk_rules: Food import controls, FSA labelling, food business registration
